title: Shared definitions
description: Types shared by every contract. Not a document type on its own. $id values are names, not download locations.

schema_version.description: Every top-level document carries `schema: <int>`. A breaking change to a contract bumps it (docs/contracts/README.md). PR3.

sha.description: A full 40-hex commit id. Abbreviated ids are ambiguous and cannot prove that a commit exists, so no stored record uses them. B4, F3.

sha_prefix.description: A commit id as a person types it. Accepted only as query input (B4), never stored.

host.description: Host key. Hostnames and API base URLs live in the private service config, never in a contract. A1.

repo.description: One repository on one host: the host key plus the namespace path as the host's API reports it. A1, B6, B9.

component_id.description: Stable component id from the registry catalogue. Lower case. A1.

configuration_id.description: Stable id of a registered SoC configuration. Used in keep/<configuration>/<component> tags (C10). B2.

commit_ref.description: A cited commit. Always structured, never free text, so T0 can prove it exists on the component's canonical host. F3.

git_ref.description: A branch or a tag. Exactly one key. B2.

utc.description: UTC timestamp, RFC 3339, with a Z suffix. A3.

semver.description: SemVer 2.0 version without a leading v. C1.

component_class.description: B1. legacy means watch-only: listed, never tested.

pin_state.description: B3 state of one pinned commit on one host. Exactly one applies, first match wins: LOCAL_URL, NO_GITLINK, UNREADABLE, TAGGED, ON_DEFAULT, PROTECTED_BY_TAG, BRANCH_ONLY, REWRITTEN, PR_ONLY, ORPHAN, MISSING. SSH-only is `url_kind: ssh` on the pin, not a state. The .gitmodules branch= field never affects the state.

gate_id.description: Gate id in the toolkit's lib.sh convention: <tier>.<subject>[.<detail>], lower case, dot separated, stable. A negative control for gate G has id G.negctl. D6, PR9.

source.description: The command or API call that produced a fact. `command` is the exact argv or `METHOD path` with no credentials in it. A3.

observed.description: Where a fact came from and when it was observed. Every fact the tool shows carries this. A3.

store_ref.description: A file in an artefact store. The store name maps to a URL in the private service config; no hostname appears here. D12, G7.
